newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honda exports rise 51.1 pct in June yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Honda exports rise 51.1 pct in June yr/yr.

text.p: Honda Motor Co Ltd said on Friday that its vehicle exports rose 51.1 percent in June from a year earlier to 47,039 units.
Its car exports in the first six months of calendar 1997 rose 50.3 percent from a year earlier to 261,175 units.
Honda's exports rose for the tenth month in a row in June, reflecting brisk sales of Honda's CR-V light sport-utility vehicle in North America and Europe, the company said in a statement.
Its June production rose 35.0 percent to 119,094 units on a year-on-year basis, the 12th consecutive month of gains, bringing January-June output to 648,814, up 26.6 percent, the company said.
Domestic sales rose in June after falling in May, helped by strong demand for its 660cc Life mini multi-purpose vehicle.
It added that overseas production rose for the 17th consecutive month, in response to strong sales in North America and Europe.

The breakdown of its domestic vehicle production, exports, domestic sales and overseas output in June were as follows (with percentage comparisons from a year earlier): Production 119,094 up 35.0 percent
The breakdown for January-June data was: Production 648,814 up 26.6 percent
